findings.title: Percent values are used as fractions
findings.explanation: The contract uses 20 for 20%. With the new formula, discountedTotal(10000, 20) returns -190000 instead of 8000.
findings.verification: Add assert.equal(discountedTotal(10000, 20), 8000) and run it locally.

findings.title: The only supplied test uses zero discount
findings.explanation: The existing zero-discount assertion passes with both formulas. It does not exercise the percentage scaling changed in this patch.
findings.verification: Add nonzero-discount cases such as 20 and boundary values 0 and 100.
